children.value: > Fact From Story: these two long-time rivals prepare for a battle that could re-define the definition of a 'physical encounter.'
> > Fact From Story: South Africa have taken their game to new heights just to reach the semis.
> > > Fact From Story: Both sides' journeys have seen twists, turns, and bumps in the road
> > > Fact From Story: England overcame a Fijian fightback in Marseille to triumph 30-24.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Journeys with twists, turns, and bumps are physical encounters.
> > Fact From Story: England are the only side still competing who are yet to lose a game, and that will stand them in good stead coming into this semi-final.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: It is difficult to play against a team that has not lost a game.
> Fact From Story: South Africa prepare to take on England in an all-or-nothing match to decide which nation gets a shot at World Cup glory
> Commonsense Knowledge: A match to decide who gets a shot at world cup glory is an important match.
